description: Create, record, or replay a local Proof Contract for a change. Returns allowed files, forbidden files, proof commands, ledger evidence, scope drift, a reviewer-ready Proof Receipt, and verifiedWorkflow status for agent handoff.

base_ref.description: Optional git base ref for changed-file detection.

changed.description: Validate the current working tree against a Proof Contract.

contract_path.description: Optional local proof contract path for changed-mode validation.

feedback_path.description: Optional local feedback artifact path to apply as trust memory.

intent.description: Plain-language change intent to constrain before editing.

ledger_path.description: Optional local Proof Ledger JSONL path.

log_path.description: Optional redacted proof log path for record_command.

max_files.description: Maximum likely touched files to include. Default: 5, max: 25.

max_tokens.description: Cap the response to roughly this many tokens.

record_command.description: Record this proof command outcome without executing it.

save_contract_path.description: Optional local path to write the generated Proof Contract in intent mode.

summary.description: Safe redacted proof output summary for record_command.

name: projscan_prove
